architecture: The game will utilize a faux-3D rendering engine, commonly known as raycasting (à la Wolfenstein 3D), implemented in vanilla JavaScript directly on an HTML5 canvas element for optimal mobile HTML5 performance. Core game logic will run in a single, optimized game loop handling updates for player, enemies, and level. Collision detection will be kept simple, relying on Axis-Aligned Bounding Boxes (AABB) for player-environment and player-enemy interactions. Mobile controls will consist of a virtual joystick for movement (forward/back, strafe left/right) on the left side of the screen, a touch-and-drag area on the right for camera look/turn, and a dedicated fire button positioned accessibly. Performance optimization will be paramount, minimizing draw calls, texture sizes, and using efficient sprite sheet rendering for 2.5D assets. Offline access will be achieved by leveraging Service Workers to cache all game assets (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, audio) after the initial download, ensuring full playability without an internet connection.

art_prompts.background: Pixel art retro FPS office interior, 2.5D style, cubicle walls, fluorescent lighting, simple textures, muted office colors, scattered office supplies, view from player perspective.
art_prompts.player: First-person view of a simple pixel art rubber band gun, slightly animated for firing, visible on the bottom of the screen, low-res texture, suitable for a retro FPS.
art_prompts.enemy: Pixel art sentient stapler enemy sprite, low-res, with an angry expression. Include multiple frames for idle, movement, attack, and death animations, in the style of retro 2.5D FPS games.
art_prompts.ui_button: Pixel art UI fire button, clear icon (e.g., small crosshair or bullet), slightly worn office supply theme, retro game style, with a subtle pressed state.

file_structure.index.html: Main entry point, sets up the HTML canvas, loads game scripts and styles.
file_structure.js/game.js: Core game logic: initializes modules, manages the main game loop, updates player, enemies, levels, handles input, and orchestrates rendering.
file_structure.css/style.css: Defines styles for the HTML page, canvas, and responsive mobile UI elements (e.g., joystick, buttons).
file_structure.serviceworker.js: Registers a service worker to cache all game assets and scripts for full offline play capability.
